gold.question: Under Directive 2011/83/EU, the parties did not agree a delivery date. The trader misses the Article 18(1) delivery period. The consumer then sets an additional period appropriate to the circumstances, and the trader still does not deliver. May the consumer terminate, and what must the trader reimburse?
gold.reference_answer: Yes. If the trader does not deliver within that additional period, the consumer may terminate the contract. Upon termination, the trader must reimburse all sums paid under the contract without undue delay. This answer concerns that additional-period route.

Delivery
1. Unless the parties have agreed otherwise on the time of delivery, the trader shall deliver the goods by transferring the physical possession or control of the goods to the consumer without undue delay, but not later than 30 days from the conclusion of the contract.
